items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: Dick Allen was gonna see her.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. We was trying to interview her. I think she lives across the lake someplace. Dick Allen was gonna see her. How did she play? Was she a good jazzy pianist or mostly classics or what'd she do?
She was a classic piano player. Some of all, she was jazz and everything else.
